remarks: Modern Townhome Minutes from Downtown Stamford Welcome to this recently renovated beautiful townhome in a quiet 12-unit community. Enjoy a rare blend of privacy, charm, and everyday convenience What You'll Love:  - Newly installed hardwood floors (2023), high ceilings, and solid wood doors  - Brick and stone exterior with large bay and picture windows for abundant natural light  - One-car attached garage plus one reserved underground parking space in rear - Open-concept living and dining leading to Trex balcony  - New recessed LED lighting  - Versatile lower-level family room or office with sliding doors to a stone patio and yard - Eat-in kitchen with granite counters, Wolf gas range, and Subzero refrigerator - Primary suite with vaulted ceilings, bay window, two walk-in closets, and a spa-style bath with soaking tub and separate new rainfall shower  - Convenient upstairs laundry with new dryer (2023)  - Top-floor bonus suite ideal for guests, remote work, or creative projects - Central AC and efficient gas heat  - Spacious closets throughout and smart home features (nest, ring, smart fan, etc)
